name: b12-claude-only
purpose: Routine workflow is MCP-accessible; credential entry remains local

given.text: Claude Code starts LocalMCPServer as an MCP stdio child process

when.text: Claude Code calls each routine tool

then.text: no MCP tool accepts or returns a credential, and provisioning is not an MCP tool
everything written to stdout is a well-formed MCP protocol message

the advertised tools are exactly connection_list, connection_remove, schema_inspect, sql_validate, sql_execute, investigation_start, investigation_record, investigation_get, knowledge_search, knowledge_propose and knowledge_review
